title: "Comparative Fungi - Chapter 3"
format:
  html:
    code-fold: true
  gfm: default
---

This document is organised in two parts:

1. **Data processing and statistical analyses**: QC, taxonomic placement and all
   tests (PERMANOVA, betadisper, Wilcoxon / Kruskal-Wallis, Mantel).
2. **Figures**: every chunk that builds or saves a figure. Figure chunk labels
   start with `fig_`. These chunks reuse objects created in part 1, so the
   document must be run top to bottom.

# Setup

## Packages and global options

```{r}
#| label: run_setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(paletteer)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggtext)
library(ggpmisc)
library(scales)
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(phangorn)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

set.seed(42)
N_PERM <- 10000

knitr::opts_chunk$set(results='hold', message=FALSE, cache = TRUE,
                      warning=FALSE, fig.show="hold",
                      out.width="100%", fig.align="center",
                      fig.width=15, fig.height=5,
                      dev=c("png", "svg", "pdf"), dpi=300)
```

## Plotting theme and helpers

```{r}
#| label: plot_helpers

save_plot <- function(path, plot, width, height, dpi = 500, bg = "white", full_save = FALSE, display = TRUE) {
  if (full_save) {
    extensions <- c("png", "svg", "tiff", "pdf")
  } else {
    extensions <- c("png")
  }

  for (ext in extensions) {
    path_comnplete <- paste0(path, ".", ext)
    ggsave(path_comnplete, plot,  width = width, height = height,  dpi = dpi, bg = bg)
  }
  if (display) {
    plot
  }
}

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

plots_theme <-  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.05)),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption        = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    strip.text          = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major    = element_blank()
  )

theme_set(plots_theme)

# Colours by reference type and taxonomic class.
ref_palette <- c(
  "Pine pathogen"      = "forestgreen",
  "Plant pathogen"     = "steelblue",
  "Animal pathogen"    = "firebrick",
  "Saprophytic fungus" = "darkorchid",
  "Common yeast"       = "darkorange1",
  "This study"         = "black"
)

class_palette <- c(
  "Dothideomycetes" = "#1B7837", "Eurotiomycetes"  = "#762A83",
  "Sordariomycetes" = "#2166AC", "Leotiomycetes"   = "#D6604D",
  "Saccharomycetes" = "#F1A340", "Tremellomycetes" = "#7F7F7F",
  "Other"           = "darkorange1"
)

# Caption explaining the coloured sample labels on the x axis.
label_caption <- paste(
  "Sample labels colored by source:\n",
  "green = pine pathogen, blue = plant pathogen, red = animal pathogen,\n",
  "purple = saprophytic fungus, orange = common yeast, black = this study."
)

                        
order_present <- function(samples, master_order) {
  present <- unique(samples)
  c(intersect(master_order, present), setdiff(present, master_order))
}

# Axis label colours matched to the plotted levels (sample or scientific name).
axis_label_colors <- function(levels_present, ref_tbl, sci_name = F, by_class = F) {
  
  if (sci_name){
  tibble(sci_plain = as.character(levels_present)) %>%
    left_join(ref_tbl %>% select(sci_plain = sci_plain, ref_color = color),
              by = "sci_plain") %>%
    mutate(ref_color = replace_na(ref_color, ref_palette[["This study"]])) %>%
    pull(ref_color)
  } else {
  tibble(sample = as.character(levels_present)) %>%
    left_join(ref_tbl %>% select(sample = sample, ref_color = color),
              by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(ref_color = replace_na(ref_color, ref_palette[["This study"]])) %>%
    pull(ref_color)
  }
}

# Adaptive color ramp (cap at the 95th percentile so an outlier does not flatten).
cap_colors <- function(mat) {
  nz  <- mat[mat > 0]
  cap <- if (length(nz)) ceiling(as.numeric(quantile(nz, 0.95))) else 1
  cap <- max(cap, 1)
  list(fun    = colorRamp2(c(0, cap), hcl_palette = "ag_GrnYl"),
       at     = c(0, round(cap / 2), cap),
       labels = c("0", as.character(round(cap / 2)), paste0(cap, "+")))
}

make_top_anno <- function(mat, ref_tbl) {
  anno_tbl <- tibble(sample = colnames(mat)) %>%
    left_join(ref_tbl %>% select(sample, class, reason), by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(
      reason = replace_na(reason, "This study"),
      class  = replace_na(class, "Unclassified")
    )

  reason <- anno_tbl %>% pull(reason)
  class  <- anno_tbl %>% pull(class)
  
  class_order <- names(class_palette[intersect(names(class_palette), unique(class))])
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(
    class = class,
    fungi = reason,
    col = list(
      class = class_palette[intersect(names(class_palette), unique(class))],
      fungi = ref_palette[intersect(names(ref_palette), unique(reason))]
    ),
    annotation_label = c(class = "Taxonomic class", fungi = "Fungal type"),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      class = list(title = "Taxonomic class", title_position = "topcenter", at = class_order),
      fungi = list(title = "Fungal type", title_position = "topcenter")
    )
  )
}

# Sample-clustered heatmap, displayed and saved to figures/<file>.png.
draw_heatmap <- function(mat, file, title = NULL, width = 20, height = 8,
                         cluster_rows = TRUE) {
  cols <- cap_colors(mat)
  h <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    name  = "genes_per_1000",
    col   = cols$fun,
    cluster_rows        = cluster_rows,
    show_row_dend       = FALSE,
    cluster_columns     = TRUE,
    show_column_names   = FALSE,
    column_dend_height  = unit(3, "cm"),
    row_gap             = unit(2, "mm"),
    row_names_side      = "left",
    row_names_max_width = unit(20, "cm"),
    column_title        = title,
    border              = TRUE,
    top_annotation      = make_top_anno(mat, tax_info),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Genes per\n1000", title_position = "topcenter",
      direction = "horizontal", legend_width = unit(3, "cm"),
      at = cols$at, labels = cols$labels)
  )
  
  h_plot <- draw(h, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
       merge_legends = TRUE)
  
  png(file.path("figures", paste0(file, ".png")), width = width, height = height,
      units = "in", res = 300)
  draw(h, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
       merge_legends = TRUE)
  dev.off()
  invisible(h)
  
  return(h_plot)
}
```

## Data and statistics helpers

```{r}
#| label: data_helpers

# Read a parser output from files/ and keep only the retained samples.
read_parsed <- function(filename, retained = FALSE) {
  path <- file.path("files", filename)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Required input missing: ", path,
         "\n  Generate it with parse_funannotate_gff3_annotations.py and copy ",
         "the CSV into files/.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (!"sample" %in% names(df)) return(df)

  doubled <- df$sample[str_detect(df$sample, "^(.+)_\\1$")]
  if (length(doubled)) {
    warning("Doubled sample names in ", filename, " (e.g. ", doubled[1],
            "). Regenerate with the current parser.")
  }
  
  if (length(retained) > 0) {
    df %>% filter(sample %in% retained)
  } else {
    df
  }
}

abbrev_binomial <- function(species) {
  parts <- strsplit(trimws(species), "\\s+")
  vapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) < 2) return(p[1])
    paste0(substr(p[1], 1, 1), ". ", paste(p[-1], collapse = " "))
  }, character(1))
}

adonis_betadisper_concat <- function (adonis, betadisper, test_label) {
  adonis |> 
  as_tibble() |> slice_head(n = 2) |> rename_with(~ paste0("adonis_", .x)) |>
                mutate(Term = c("class", "lifestyle"),
                       Test = test_label, .before = 1) -> adonis_df
  if (betadisper) {
    anova(betadisper) |>
      as_tibble() |> slice_head(n = 1) |> rename_with(~ paste0("betadisper_", .x)) |> 
      mutate(Term = "class", .before=1) -> betadisper_df
    
    adonis_df |> left_join(betadisper_df, by = "Term")
  } else {
    adonis_df
  }
}

pct_of <- function(x, v) 100 * mean(x < v) + 50 * mean(x == v)  # midrank percentile
```

# Data processing and statistical analyses

## QC

### QC filtering

```{r}
#| label: qc_setup

MIN_COMPLETE   <- 70   # BUSCO complete (%)   -- inclusive lower bound
MAX_DUPLICATED <- 15   # BUSCO duplicated (%) -- exclusive upper bound

busco   <- read_tsv("files/busco_summary.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
quast   <- read_tsv("files/quast_summary.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
            mutate(Assembly = str_remove(Assembly, ".links"))
rptmask <- read_csv("files/repeatmasker_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

qc_all <- busco %>%
  left_join(quast,   by = c("sample_name" = "Assembly")) %>%
  left_join(rptmask, by = c("sample_name" = "sample")) %>%
  rename(sample = sample_name) |> 
  mutate(
    genome_size_mb = `Total length` / 1e6,
    adj_genome_size_mb = ((`Total length` * (sc_percent /100)) / (c_percent /100)) / 1e6,
    n50_kb         = N50 / 1e3,
    passes_qc      = c_percent >= MIN_COMPLETE & mc_percent < MAX_DUPLICATED,
    qc_status      = if_else(passes_qc, "Retained", "Excluded")
  ) |>
  rename(repeat_percent = bases_masked) |> left_join(sci_name) |> 
  mutate(sample_type = ifelse(sample %in% reference_samples$sample, "ref", "isolate"),
         sci_plain = case_when(sample_type == "isolate" ~ sample),
         sci_expr = case_when(sample_type == "isolate" ~ sample),
         sci_md = case_when(sample_type == "isolate" ~ gsub("_", "\\_", sample)))

retained_samples <- c(qc_all %>% filter(passes_qc) %>% pull(sample))
write(qc_all %>% filter(passes_qc) %>% pull(sample), file = "files/retained_samples.txt")

name_scheme <- qc_all |> select(sample, sample_type, sci_plain, sci_expr, sci_md)
sample_order <- c(
  qc_all %>% filter(passes_qc) %>% arrange(desc(genome_size_mb)) %>% pull(sample)
)

message(sprintf("QC: %d of %d genomes retained (complete >= %d%%, duplicated < %d%%)",
                length(retained_samples), nrow(qc_all), MIN_COMPLETE, MAX_DUPLICATED))
```

### QC summary statistics

```{r}
#| label: qc_stats

qc_all |>
  filter(sample_type == "isolate") |> 
  summarise(mean_genome_size  =   mean(genome_size_mb),
            medi_genome_size  = median(genome_size_mb),
            mini_genome_size  =    min(genome_size_mb),
            maxi_genome_size  =    max(genome_size_mb),
            
            mean_contigs  =   mean(`# contigs`),
            medi_contigs  = median(`# contigs`),
            mini_contigs  =    min(`# contigs`),
            maxi_contigs  =    max(`# contigs`),
            
            mean_n50  =   mean(n50_kb),
            medi_n50  = median(n50_kb),
            mini_n50  =    min(n50_kb),
            maxi_n50  =    max(n50_kb),
            
            mean_busco_c  =   mean(c_percent),
            medi_busco_c  = median(c_percent),
            mini_busco_c  =    min(c_percent),
            maxi_busco_c  =    max(c_percent),
            ) |> t()
   
```

## Taxonomic placement from the tree

```{r}
#| label: taxonomic_placement
#| warning: TRUE

# Tree with branch lengths (patristic distances) and UFBoot support as node labels.

tr <- read.tree("files/iqtree_outgroup_unpart_70_taxonomy.tree")
tr$tip.label <- gsub("^'|'$", "", tr$tip.label)
stopifnot("tip labels still contain a quote character after stripping" =
          !any(grepl("'", tr$tip.label)))

# Support values must be present as numeric node labels.
if (is.null(tr$node.label) || all(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label))))) {
  stop("This tree has no numeric node labels. Either it lacks support values ",
       "(check IQ-TREE was run with -B/--alrt) or they are in a format ",
       "as.numeric() cannot read. Inspect head(tr$node.label).")
}
n_lab_before <- sum(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label))))

# Root on the Basidiomycota outgroup.
basid <- grep("^Basidiomycota", tr$tip.label, value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(basid) >= 2)
tr <- root(tr, outgroup = basid, resolve.root = TRUE, edgelabel = TRUE)

# Rooting can drop node labels; report how many were lost.
supp <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label))
n_lab_after <- sum(!is.na(supp))
cat(sprintf("node labels: %d before rooting, %d after (%d lost)\n",
            n_lab_before, n_lab_after, n_lab_before - n_lab_after))
if (n_lab_before - n_lab_after > 2) {
  warning("Rerooting dropped more than two node labels. Support for placements ",
          "near the root may be unreliable. Consider bipartition matching on ",
          "the unrooted tree instead.")
}

is_ref   <- grepl("\\|", tr$tip.label)
ref_tips <- tr$tip.label[is_ref]
qry_tips <- setdiff(tr$tip.label[!is_ref], "Neurospora_crassa_genomic")

D <- cophenetic.phylo(tr)

# Split the pipe-delimited reference lineages into ranks.
lineage <- function(x) trimws(strsplit(x, "\\|")[[1]])
RANKS <- c("phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")
ref_lin <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ref_tips, function(x) {
  l <- lineage(x); length(l) <- 6; l
}))
rownames(ref_lin) <- ref_tips
colnames(ref_lin) <- RANKS

# Rank calibration: patristic distances between reference pairs sharing each rank.
pairs <- t(combn(ref_tips, 2))
shared_rank <- apply(pairs, 1, function(p) {
  a <- ref_lin[p[1], ]; b <- ref_lin[p[2], ]
  sh <- NA
  for (i in 1:5) if (!is.na(a[i]) && !is.na(b[i]) && a[i] == b[i]) sh <- RANKS[i] else break
  sh
})
calib <- tibble(
  rank = shared_rank,
  d    = D[cbind(pairs[, 1], pairs[, 2])]
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rank)) %>%
  group_by(rank) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_d = median(d), p10 = quantile(d, .1), p90 = quantile(d, .9))

cat("\n=== Rank calibration: patristic distance between reference pairs ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(calib))

med <- setNames(calib$median_d, calib$rank)

# UFBoot support of the smallest clade containing the query and at least one reference.
ntip      <- length(tr$tip.label)
root_node <- ntip + 1L

support_for <- function(tip) {
  i <- match(tip, tr$tip.label)
  if (is.na(i)) return(NA_real_)
  path <- rev(nodepath(tr, from = root_node, to = i))   # tip-to-root
  path <- path[-1]                                      # drop the tip itself
  for (nd in path) {
    desc <- Descendants(tr, nd, type = "tips")[[1]]
    if (any(grepl("\\|", tr$tip.label[desc]))) return(supp[nd - ntip])
  }
  NA_real_   # no ancestral clade contains a reference tip
}

# Nearest reference and minimum assignable rank for each query.
placement <- map_dfr(qry_tips, function(q) {
  d_to_refs <- D[q, ref_tips]
  nearest   <- names(which.min(d_to_refs))
  dmin      <- min(d_to_refs)
  lin       <- ref_lin[nearest, ]
  min_rank <- dplyr::case_when(
    dmin < 0.020         ~ "species-level candidate",
    dmin < med["genus"]  ~ "genus",
    dmin < med["family"] ~ "genus (tentative)",
    dmin < med["order"]  ~ "family",
    dmin < med["class"]  ~ "order",
    TRUE                 ~ "class"
  )
  tibble(sample = q, class = lin[["class"]], order = lin[["order"]],
         family = lin[["family"]], nearest_reference = lin[["species"]],
         patristic_dist = dmin, min_rank = min_rank,
         UFBoot = support_for(q))
})

cat("\n=== Collection composition by class ===\n")
print(table(placement$class))

cat("\n=== Minimum assignable rank ===\n")
print(placement |>
        group_by(min_rank) |>
        summarise(n_rank = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
        arrange(desc(n_rank)))

cat("\n=== UFBoot support for placements ===\n")
print(summary(placement$UFBoot))
cat("\nplacements with support < 95:\n")
print(placement %>% filter(UFBoot < 95) %>%
      select(sample, class, nearest_reference, patristic_dist, UFBoot))

if (n_distinct(na.omit(placement$UFBoot)) <= 1) {
  warning("All non-NA UFBoot values are identical, the signature of the ",
          "root-collision bug. Verify the traversal before trusting these.")
}
if (any(is.na(placement$UFBoot))) {
  cat(sprintf("\nNOTE: %d placement(s) have NA support:\n",
              sum(is.na(placement$UFBoot))))
  print(placement %>% filter(is.na(UFBoot)) %>%
        select(sample, class, nearest_reference))
}

write_csv(placement, "files/taxonomic_placements_R.csv")
```

## Sample metadata (class and lifestyle)

```{r}
#| label: add_taxonomy

allowed  <- c("Dothideomycetes",
              "Eurotiomycetes",
              "Sordariomycetes")

tax_info <- placement |>
              mutate(reason = "This study") |> 
              bind_rows(reference_samples) |> 
              select(sample, class, order, family, reason) |> 
              mutate(class = ifelse(class %in% allowed, class, "Other"))

meta <- tibble(sample = qc_all$sample) %>%
          left_join(placement %>% select(sample, class), by = "sample") %>%
          mutate(
            class     = coalesce(class, ref_class[sample]),
            lifestyle = coalesce(ref_lifestyle[sample], "Endophyte")
          )

stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$class)))
```

## CAZy

### CAZy family composition (PERMANOVA)

```{r}
#| label: permanova_cazy

cazy_mat <- read_csv("files/matrix_cazy_family_per1000.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")
cazy_mat <- cazy_mat[, colSums(cazy_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
cazy_mat[is.na(cazy_mat)] <- 0

# Euclidean distance on Hellinger-transformed data is the Hellinger distance.
hell <- decostand(cazy_mat, method = "hellinger")

# Filamentous fungi only (yeast-like references excluded).
keep <- meta$sample[!meta$sample %in% YEAST_LIKE]
cazy_h  <- hell[keep, ]
cazy_m  <- meta %>% filter(sample %in% keep) %>% arrange(match(sample, rownames(cazy_h)))
cazy_d  <- vegdist(cazy_h, method = "euclidean")

cat("=== PERMANOVA, filamentous fungi only (n =", length(keep), ") ===\n")
cat("\n-- taxonomic class --\n")
print(adonis2(cazy_d ~ class, data = cazy_m, permutations = N_PERM))
cat("\n-- lifestyle --\n")
print(adonis2(cazy_d ~ lifestyle, data = cazy_m, permutations = N_PERM))

# Sequential terms: class is fitted before lifestyle.
cat("\n-- class + lifestyle (sequential) --\n")
print(adonis2(cazy_d ~ class + lifestyle, data = cazy_m, permutations = N_PERM, by = "terms" ))

cat("\n=== betadisper (homogeneity of dispersion) ===\n")
bd <- betadisper(cazy_d, cazy_m$class)
print(anova(bd))

dk  <- cazy_m$sample[cazy_m$class == "Dothideomycetes"]
h_d <- hell[dk, ]
m_d <- cazy_m %>% filter(sample %in% dk) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, rownames(h_d)))

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA within Dothideomycetes (n =", length(dk), ") ===\n")
print(table(m_d$lifestyle))
print(adonis2(vegdist(h_d, "euclidean") ~ lifestyle, data = m_d, permutations = N_PERM))

sk  <- cazy_m$sample[cazy_m$lifestyle == "Endophyte"]
m_s <- cazy_m %>% filter(sample %in% sk) %>% arrange(match(sample, rownames(hell[sk, ])))
cat("\n=== PERMANOVA, study isolates only, by class (n =", length(sk), ") ===\n")
print(adonis2(vegdist(hell[sk, ], "euclidean") ~ class, data = m_s, permutations = N_PERM))
```

### Fraction of CAZymes secreted

```{r}
#| label: cazy_secretion_stat

sec_test_df <- read_csv("files/secreted_cazyme_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!(secreted_cazyme_genes == 0 & nonsecreted_cazyme_genes == 0)) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")

dot_endo_sec <- sec_test_df %>%
  filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", class == "Dothideomycetes") %>%
  pull(percent_of_cazymes_secreted)

needle_sec <- sec_test_df %>%
  filter(sample %in% c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum")) %>%
  pull(percent_of_cazymes_secreted)

cat("=== Secreted CAZyme %: Dothideomycete endophytes vs the 2 needle specialists ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  endophytes n = %d, median = %.1f%% ; pathogens = %s\n",
            length(dot_endo_sec), median(dot_endo_sec),
            paste(sprintf("%.1f%%", needle_sec), collapse = ", ")))
print(wilcox.test(dot_endo_sec, needle_sec, exact = FALSE))

cat(sprintf("  L. acicola percentile among matched endophytes = %.1f\n",
            pct_of(dot_endo_sec,
                   sec_test_df$percent_of_cazymes_secreted[sec_test_df$sample == "Lacicola"])))

patho_sec <- sec_test_df %>%
  filter(sample %in% c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum", "Dsapinea", "Ztritici")) %>%
  pull(percent_of_cazymes_secreted)

cat("=== Secreted CAZyme %: Dothideomycete endophytes vs the 4 plant pathogens ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  endophytes n = %d, median = %.1f%% ; pathogens = %s\n",
            length(dot_endo_sec), median(dot_endo_sec),
            paste(sprintf("%.1f%%", patho_sec), collapse = ", ")))
```

### PCWDE: pathogen positions among matched Dothideomycetes

```{r}
#| label: pcwde_positions

DOT_PATH <- c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum", "Dsapinea", "Ztritici")
NEEDLE   <- c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum")

positions <- function(tbl, traits, paths = DOT_PATH) {
  dot <- tbl %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", class == "Dothideomycetes")
  for (trait in traits) {
    x <- dot[[trait]]
    cat(sprintf("\n-- %s: Dothideomycete isolates n = %d, mean %.2f, median %.2f, range %.2f-%.2f\n",
                trait, length(x), mean(x), median(x), min(x), max(x)))
    for (p in paths) {
      v <- tbl[[trait]][tbl$sample == p]
      cat(sprintf("   %-13s %6.2f  percentile %5.1f  (isolates below: %d)\n",
                  p, v, pct_of(x, v), sum(x < v)))
    }
    y <- tbl[[trait]][tbl$sample %in% NEEDLE]
    w <- wilcox.test(x, y)
    cat(sprintf("   Wilcoxon, 2 needle pathogens vs isolates: W = %.1f, p = %.4f\n",
                w$statistic, w$p.value))
  }
}

act <- read_csv("files/cazy_activity_group_counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(unique(act$activity_group))   # confirm these names match the vector below

short <- c("Cellulose-associated (PCWDE)"           = "Cellulose",
           "Hemicellulose / xylan-associated (PCWDE)" = "Hemicellulose",
           "Mannan-associated (PCWDE)"               = "Mannan",
           "Pectin-associated (PCWDE)"               = "Pectin")

# Total PCWDE = cellulose + hemicellulose + mannan + pectin (cutin excluded).
pcwde_wide <- act %>%
  filter(activity_group %in% names(short)) %>%
  mutate(trait = short[activity_group]) %>%
  select(sample, trait, n_genes_per_1000) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = n_genes_per_1000, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total_PCWDE = Cellulose + Hemicellulose + Mannan + Pectin) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")

cat("=== total PCWDE by class, study isolates ===\n")
print(pcwde_wide %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte") %>%
      group_by(class) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean = round(mean(Total_PCWDE), 1),
                min = round(min(Total_PCWDE), 1), max = round(max(Total_PCWDE), 1)))

cat("\n=== minimum across ALL study isolates ===\n")
print(pcwde_wide %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte") %>%
      summarise(across(c(Cellulose, Pectin, Total_PCWDE), ~round(min(.x), 2))))

positions(pcwde_wide, c("Cellulose", "Pectin", "Hemicellulose", "Total_PCWDE"))
```

```{r}
#| label: pathogen_percentiles

pathogen_positions <- function(tbl, traits) {
  denoms <- list(
    "Dothideomycete isolates (matched)" =
      tbl %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", class == "Dothideomycetes"),
    "All study isolates (unmatched)" =
      tbl %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte"))

  pct <- map_dfr(names(denoms), function(dn) {
    map_dfr(traits, function(trait) {
      x <- denoms[[dn]][[trait]]
      map_dfr(DOT_PATH, function(s) {
        v <- tbl[[trait]][tbl$sample == s]
        tibble(denominator = dn, trait = trait, sample = s, value = v,
               percentile = pct_of(x, v), n_below = sum(x < v),
               n_equal = sum(x == v), n_isolates = length(x))
      })
    })
  })

  tests <- map_dfr(names(denoms), function(dn) {
    map_dfr(traits, function(trait) {
      x <- denoms[[dn]][[trait]]
      y <- tbl[[trait]][tbl$sample %in% NEEDLE]
      w <- wilcox.test(x, y)
      tibble(denominator = dn, trait = trait, n_isolates = length(x),
             mean = mean(x), median = median(x), min = min(x), max = max(x),
             W = unname(w$statistic), p = w$p.value)
    })
  }) %>%
    group_by(denominator) %>%
    mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()

  list(pct = pct, tests = tests)
}

traits <- c("Cellulose", "Pectin", "Hemicellulose", "Total_PCWDE")
incl <- pathogen_positions(pcwde_wide, traits)

cat("=== percentile of each Dothideomycete pathogen reference ===\n")
print(incl$pct %>% mutate(across(c(value, percentile), ~round(.x, 2))), n = Inf)

cat("\n=== needle specialists (2) vs isolates, two-sided Wilcoxon ===\n")
print(incl$tests %>% mutate(across(c(mean, median, min, max), ~round(.x, 2)), p = signif(p, 3), p_BH = signif(p_BH, 3)), n = Inf)

print(incl$tests %>% select(denominator, trait, p, p_BH) %>%
      mutate(across(c(p, p_BH), ~signif(.x, 3))), n = Inf)
```

### PCWDE: robustness to double counting (inclusive vs exclusive counts)

```{r}
#| label: pcwde_robustness

fam_map <- read_csv("files_unfiltered/cazy_family_activity_map.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(cazy_family, activity_group)
n_groups <- fam_map %>% count(cazy_family, name = "n_groups")

cat("=== families in more than one group, by map membership ===\n")
print(fam_map %>% semi_join(filter(n_groups, n_groups > 1), by = "cazy_family") %>%
      arrange(cazy_family, activity_group), n = Inf)

# One row per gene and CAZy family.
flat <- read_csv("files/gene_annotation_flat_table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cz <- flat %>%
  filter(!is.na(cazy_families_norm), cazy_families_norm != "") %>%
  select(sample, transcript_id, cazy_families_norm) %>%
  separate_rows(cazy_families_norm, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(cazy_family = trimws(cazy_families_norm)) %>%
  filter(cazy_family != "") %>%
  distinct(sample, transcript_id, cazy_family)

cat(sprintf("\nfamilies in the genomes but absent from the map: %d\n",
            length(setdiff(unique(cz$cazy_family), fam_map$cazy_family))))

tx <- cz %>%
  inner_join(fam_map, by = "cazy_family") %>%
  left_join(n_groups, by = "cazy_family")

totals <- read_csv("files/product_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(sample, total_genes = total_mrna_features)

# A gene counts in a group (inclusive) if it has any family in it, and
# (exclusive) if it has at least one family assigned to that group alone.
grp_counts <- tx %>%
  group_by(sample, transcript_id, activity_group) %>%
  summarise(incl = 1L, excl = as.integer(any(n_groups == 1)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample, activity_group) %>%
  summarise(inclusive = sum(incl), exclusive = sum(excl), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(across(c(inclusive, exclusive), ~ .x / total_genes * 1000)) %>%
  select(-total_genes) %>%
  complete(sample = totals$sample, activity_group = unique(fam_map$activity_group),
           fill = list(inclusive = 0, exclusive = 0))

# Inclusive counts should reproduce cazy_activity_group_counts.csv.
chk <- grp_counts %>%
  left_join(act %>% select(sample, activity_group, file_value = n_genes_per_1000),
            by = c("sample", "activity_group"))
cat(sprintf("\nmax |inclusive - file value| = %.4f\n",
            max(abs(chk$inclusive - replace_na(chk$file_value, 0)))))

# Unique-gene totals across the four PCWDE groups (no double counting).
pc <- names(short)
union_tot <- tibble(sample = totals$sample) %>%
  left_join(tx %>% filter(activity_group %in% pc) %>%
              distinct(sample, transcript_id) %>% count(sample, name = "n_incl"),
            by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(tx %>% filter(activity_group %in% pc, n_groups == 1) %>%
              distinct(sample, transcript_id) %>% count(sample, name = "n_excl"),
            by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "sample") %>%
  transmute(sample,
            total_inclusive = replace_na(n_incl, 0L) / total_genes * 1000,
            total_exclusive = replace_na(n_excl, 0L) / total_genes * 1000)

make_wide <- function(col) {
  grp_counts %>%
    filter(activity_group %in% pc) %>%
    mutate(trait = short[activity_group]) %>%
    select(sample, trait, value = all_of(col)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
    left_join(union_tot %>% select(sample, Total_PCWDE = all_of(paste0("total_", col))),
              by = "sample") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "sample")
}

# Summed vs unique-gene total PCWDE.
incl_wide <- make_wide("inclusive")
cat("\n=== total PCWDE: summed groups (previous) vs unique genes, by class ===\n")
print(pcwde_wide %>% select(sample, Sum_total = Total_PCWDE) %>%
      left_join(incl_wide %>% select(sample, Unique_total = Total_PCWDE, class, lifestyle),
                by = "sample") %>%
      filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte") %>%
      group_by(class) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), summed = round(mean(Sum_total), 1),
                unique = round(mean(Unique_total), 1)))
cat("\nDothideomycete references, summed vs unique total:\n")
print(pcwde_wide %>% filter(sample %in% DOT_PATH) %>% select(sample, summed = Total_PCWDE) %>%
      left_join(incl_wide %>% select(sample, unique = Total_PCWDE), by = "sample") %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2))))

# Retention of each group under exclusive counting.
cat("\n=== retention under exclusive counting ===\n")
print(grp_counts %>%
      group_by(activity_group) %>%
      summarise(pct_retained_pooled = 100 * sum(exclusive) / sum(inclusive),
                pct_retained_mean = 100 * mean(exclusive[inclusive > 0] / inclusive[inclusive > 0]),
                r_pearson = suppressWarnings(cor(inclusive, exclusive)),
                rho_spearman = suppressWarnings(cor(inclusive, exclusive, method = "spearman")),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))), n = Inf)

# Pathogen positions using exclusive counts.
excl_wide <- make_wide("exclusive")
excl <- pathogen_positions(excl_wide, c("Cellulose", "Pectin", "Hemicellulose", "Total_PCWDE"))

cat("\n=== EXCLUSIVE counts, matched Dothideomycete comparison ===\n")
print(excl$pct %>% filter(startsWith(denominator, "Dothideomycete")) %>%
      mutate(across(c(value, percentile), ~round(.x, 2))), n = Inf)
print(excl$tests %>% filter(startsWith(denominator, "Dothideomycete")) %>%
      mutate(across(c(mean, median, min, max), ~round(.x, 2)),
             p = signif(p, 3), p_BH = signif(p_BH, 3)), n = Inf)

# Pathogen positions using unique-gene totals under inclusive counting.
cat("\n=== INCLUSIVE counts with unique-gene total, matched comparison ===\n")
incl_u <- pathogen_positions(incl_wide, c("Cellulose", "Pectin", "Total_PCWDE"))
print(incl_u$tests %>% filter(startsWith(denominator, "Dothideomycete")) %>%
      mutate(across(c(mean, median, min, max), ~round(.x, 2)),
             p = signif(p, 3), p_BH = signif(p_BH, 3)), n = Inf)
```

## Secretome

### Effectors (EffectorP)

```{r}
#| label: effector_tests

eff_sum <- read_csv("files/effectorp_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")

# The matched comparison needs EffectorP results for both needle pathogens.
refs_present <- eff_sum %>% filter(lifestyle != "Endophyte") %>% pull(sample)
needle       <- intersect(c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum"), eff_sum$sample)

cat(sprintf("genomes with EffectorP results: %d (%d endophytes, %d references)\n",
            nrow(eff_sum), sum(eff_sum$lifestyle == "Endophyte"), length(refs_present)))
cat("reference genomes present:", paste(refs_present, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (length(needle) < 2) {
  stop("EffectorP results are missing for ", 
       paste(setdiff(c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum"), eff_sum$sample), collapse = " and "),
       ". The matched pathogen comparison cannot be run. Either run EffectorP on ",
       "the reference genomes, or drop effector claims from the paper.")
}

# n_proteins_screened is the secretome after the TM filter (EffectorP input).
eff_sum <- eff_sum %>%
  mutate(
    secretome_per_1000 = n_proteins_screened / total_genes * 1000,
    effectors_per_1000 = n_effectors / total_genes * 1000,
    pct_secretome_effector = 100 * n_effectors / n_proteins_screened
  )

cat("\n=== per-genome rates by lifestyle ===\n")
print(eff_sum %>% group_by(lifestyle) %>%
      summarise(n = n(),
                secretome_per_1000 = round(mean(secretome_per_1000), 2),
                effectors_per_1000 = round(mean(effectors_per_1000), 2),
                pct_secretome_effector = round(mean(pct_secretome_effector), 1)))

# Effector content by taxonomic class (study isolates).
eff_study <- eff_sum %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", !is.na(class))
cls_n <- eff_study %>% count(class) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(class)
kw_eff <- eff_study %>% filter(class %in% cls_n)

cat("\n=== effector content by taxonomic class (study isolates) ===\n")
print(kw_eff %>% group_by(class) %>%
      summarise(n = n(),
                median_eff_per_1000 = round(median(effectors_per_1000), 2),
                median_sec_per_1000 = round(median(secretome_per_1000), 2)))

cat("\n-- effectors per 1000 genes ~ class --\n")
print(kruskal.test(effectors_per_1000 ~ factor(class), data = kw_eff))
print(pairwise.wilcox.test(kw_eff$effectors_per_1000, factor(kw_eff$class),
                           p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE))

cat("\n-- secretome size per 1000 genes ~ class --\n")
print(kruskal.test(secretome_per_1000 ~ factor(class), data = kw_eff))

# Dothideomycete endophytes vs needle pathogens.
dot_endo <- eff_sum %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", class == "Dothideomycetes")
path_row <- eff_sum %>% filter(sample %in% needle)

cat(sprintf("\n=== matched comparison: %d Dothideomycete endophytes vs %d needle specialists ===\n",
            nrow(dot_endo), nrow(path_row)))

for (v in c("secretome_per_1000", "effectors_per_1000", "pct_secretome_effector")) {
  x <- dot_endo[[v]]
  y <- path_row[[v]]
  w <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\n  %s\n", v))
  cat(sprintf("    endophytes: median %.2f [%.2f - %.2f]\n",
              median(x), min(x), max(x)))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(path_row))) {
    cat(sprintf("    %-14s %.2f  (percentile %.1f)\n",
                path_row$sample[i], y[i], pct_of(x, y[i])))
  }
  cat(sprintf("    Wilcoxon W = %.1f, p = %.3f\n", w$statistic, w$p.value))
}

# Effector class composition (apoplastic / cytoplasmic / dual).
eff_cls <- read_csv("files/effectorp_class_counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(effector_class != "Non-effector") %>%
  select(sample, effector_class, n_genes) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = effector_class, values_from = n_genes, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")
eff_cls <- eff_cls[rowSums(eff_cls) > 0, colSums(eff_cls) > 0, drop = FALSE]

eff_meta <- meta %>%
  filter(sample %in% rownames(eff_cls), !sample %in% YEAST_LIKE) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, rownames(eff_cls)))
eff_h <- decostand(eff_cls[eff_meta$sample, ], method = "hellinger")
eff_d <- vegdist(eff_h, method = "euclidean")

cat(sprintf("\n=== PERMANOVA on effector class composition (%d categories, n = %d) ===\n",
            ncol(eff_cls), nrow(eff_h)))
print(adonis2(eff_d ~ class,     data = eff_meta, permutations = N_PERM))
print(adonis2(eff_d ~ lifestyle, data = eff_meta, permutations = N_PERM))
print(adonis2(eff_d ~ class + lifestyle, data = eff_meta, permutations = N_PERM, by = "terms"))
cat("\n-- dispersion check (as for CAZy and BGC) --\n")
print(anova(betadisper(eff_d, eff_meta$class)))
print(anova(betadisper(eff_d, eff_meta$lifestyle)))

# Effectors are a subset of the secretome: check whether effector counts only
# track secretome size.
ct <- cor.test(eff_sum$secretome_per_1000, eff_sum$effectors_per_1000,
               method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\n=== nesting check ===\n  secretome size vs effector count: rho = %+.3f, p = %.3g\n",
            ct$estimate, ct$p.value))
ct2 <- cor.test(eff_sum$secretome_per_1000, eff_sum$pct_secretome_effector,
                method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("  secretome size vs effector FRACTION: rho = %+.3f, p = %.3g\n",
            ct2$estimate, ct2$p.value))
cat("  If the first is strong and the second is near zero, effector count is\n")
cat("  largely tracking secretome size and the two should not be reported as\n")
cat("  independent results.\n")
```

### Secreted CAZy composition

```{r}
#| label: secreted_cazy_matrix

# Secreted CAZymes only. This is a subset of the full CAZy matrix, so it is
# analysed separately and not added to the combined matrix.

flat <- read_csv("files/gene_annotation_flat_table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# passed_tm_filter: NA = not screened, TRUE = secreted, FALSE = membrane-bound.
secreted <- flat %>%
  filter(!is.na(passed_tm_filter), passed_tm_filter) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cazy_families_norm), cazy_families_norm != "")

cat(sprintf("secreted transcripts with a CAZy assignment: %d across %d genomes\n",
            nrow(secreted), n_distinct(secreted$sample)))

# Genomes without secretome coverage are missing data, not zeros.
no_coverage <- flat %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(any_assessed = any(secretome_assessed), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!any_assessed) %>% pull(sample)
if (length(no_coverage)) {
  cat(sprintf("EXCLUDED, no secretome coverage (missing data, not zero): %s\n",
              paste(no_coverage, collapse = ", ")))
}

# cazy_families_norm is ';'-delimited.
sec_long <- secreted %>%
  select(sample, transcript_id, cazy_families_norm) %>%
  separate_rows(cazy_families_norm, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(cazy_family = trimws(cazy_families_norm)) %>%
  filter(cazy_family != "") %>%
  distinct(sample, transcript_id, cazy_family)

totals <- read_csv("files/product_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(sample, total_genes = total_mrna_features)

sec_counts <- sec_long %>%
  count(sample, cazy_family, name = "n_genes") %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(per_1000 = n_genes / total_genes * 1000)

write_csv(sec_counts, "files/secreted_cazy_family_counts.csv")

sec_mat <- sec_counts %>%
  select(sample, cazy_family, per_1000) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cazy_family, values_from = per_1000, values_fill = 0) %>%
  filter(!sample %in% no_coverage) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")

cat(sprintf("secreted-CAZy matrix: %d genomes x %d families\n",
            nrow(sec_mat), ncol(sec_mat)))
cat(sprintf("  (full CAZy matrix for comparison: %d x %d)\n",
            nrow(cazy_mat), ncol(cazy_mat)))
```

```{r}
# Dothideomycete endophytes vs needle pathogens.
sec_group <- sec_counts %>%
  filter(!sample %in% no_coverage) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(secreted_cazy_per_1000 = sum(per_1000), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")

dot_e <- sec_group %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", class == "Dothideomycetes")
needle <- sec_group %>% filter(sample %in% c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum"))

cat(sprintf("\n=== total secreted CAZyme content: %d Dothideomycete endophytes vs %d needle specialists ===\n",
            nrow(dot_e), nrow(needle)))
cat(sprintf("  endophytes: median %.2f [%.2f - %.2f]\n",
            median(dot_e$secreted_cazy_per_1000),
            min(dot_e$secreted_cazy_per_1000), max(dot_e$secreted_cazy_per_1000)))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(needle))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-14s %.2f  (percentile %.1f)\n", needle$sample[i],
              needle$secreted_cazy_per_1000[i],
              pct_of(dot_e$secreted_cazy_per_1000, needle$secreted_cazy_per_1000[i])))
}
print(wilcox.test(dot_e$secreted_cazy_per_1000, needle$secreted_cazy_per_1000,
                  exact = FALSE))

cat("\n=== by class (study isolates) ===\n")
print(sec_group %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", !is.na(class)) %>%
      group_by(class) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), median = round(median(secreted_cazy_per_1000), 2)))

cat("=== betadisper on LIFESTYLE (the factor the new claim rests on) ===\n")
print(anova(betadisper(sec_d, sec_meta$lifestyle)))

# Which families drive the lifestyle signal, and in which direction?
sec_rel <- sweep(sec_mat[sec_meta$sample, ], 1, rowSums(sec_mat[sec_meta$sample, ]), "/")
fam_test <- map_dfr(colnames(sec_rel), function(f) {
  d <- tibble(v = sec_rel[, f], lifestyle = sec_meta$lifestyle) %>%
    filter(lifestyle %in% c("Endophyte", "Pathogen"))
  if (sum(d$v > 0) < 5) return(NULL)
  w <- wilcox.test(v ~ lifestyle, data = d, exact = FALSE)
  tibble(family = f, p = w$p.value,
         endophyte = mean(d$v[d$lifestyle == "Endophyte"]),
         pathogen  = mean(d$v[d$lifestyle == "Pathogen"]))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
         direction = if_else(pathogen > endophyte, "higher in pathogens",
                             "higher in endophytes")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

cat("\n=== families differing by lifestyle (BH-adjusted, top 15) ===\n")
print(fam_test %>% head(15) %>%
      mutate(across(c(endophyte, pathogen), ~round(.x, 4)),
             p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3)))
cat(sprintf("\nfamilies with p_adj < 0.05: %d of %d tested\n",
            sum(fam_test$p_adj < 0.05), nrow(fam_test)))
```

## COG

```{r}
#| label: cog_stats

# COG profiles, filamentous fungi only.

cog_raw <- read_parsed("cog_category_counts.csv", retained_samples)

cog_mat <- cog_raw %>%
  select(sample, category, count_per_1000_genes) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = count_per_1000_genes,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")
cog_mat <- cog_mat[, colSums(cog_mat) > 0, drop = FALSE]

cog_meta <- meta %>%
  filter(sample %in% rownames(cog_mat), !sample %in% YEAST_LIKE) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, rownames(cog_mat)))
cog_h <- decostand(cog_mat[cog_meta$sample, ], method = "hellinger")
cog_d <- vegdist(cog_h, method = "euclidean")

cat("=== PERMANOVA on COG profiles, filamentous only (n =", nrow(cog_h), ") ===\n")
cat("\n-- lifestyle --\n")
print(adonis2(cog_d ~ lifestyle, data = cog_meta, permutations = N_PERM))
cat("\n-- taxonomic class --\n")
print(adonis2(cog_d ~ class, data = cog_meta, permutations = N_PERM))
cat("\n-- lifestyle + taxonomic class --\n")
print(adonis2(cog_d ~ class + lifestyle, data = cog_meta, permutations = N_PERM, by = "terms"))
cat("\n-- dispersion check --\n")
print(anova(betadisper(cog_d, cog_meta$class)))

# Dothideomycetes only: endophytes vs pathogens.

cog_dot <- cog_meta %>% filter(class == "Dothideomycetes")
cog_h_dot <- cog_h[cog_dot$sample, , drop = FALSE]

cog_dot <- cog_dot %>%
  mutate(grp = if_else(lifestyle == "Pathogen", "Pathogen", "Endophyte"))

cat("=== PERMANOVA on COG profiles, Dothideomycetes only (n =", nrow(cog_h_dot), ") ===\n")
print(table(cog_dot$grp))
print(adonis2(vegdist(cog_h_dot, "euclidean") ~ grp,
              data = cog_dot, permutations = N_PERM))

cat("\n-- dispersion check --\n")
print(anova(betadisper(vegdist(cog_h_dot, "euclidean"), cog_dot$grp)))

# Per-category Wilcoxon tests, BH-corrected.
dot_endo_cog <- cog_mat[cog_dot$sample[cog_dot$grp == "Endophyte"], , drop = FALSE]
needle_cog   <- cog_mat[intersect(c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum"), rownames(cog_mat)), , drop = FALSE]

cat("\n=== per-category Wilcoxon, BH-corrected ===\n")
cog_p <- sapply(colnames(cog_mat), function(cat_i) {
  wilcox.test(dot_endo_cog[, cat_i], needle_cog[, cat_i], exact = FALSE)$p.value
})
print(tibble(category = names(cog_p),
             endo_median = round(apply(dot_endo_cog, 2, median), 2),
             needle = apply(needle_cog, 2, function(x) paste(round(x, 2), collapse = "/")),
             p_adj = round(p.adjust(cog_p, method = "BH"), 3)) %>%
      arrange(p_adj))
```

## BGC

### BGC counts by class and matched comparison

```{r}
#| label: bgc_counts

bgc_raw <- read_parsed("antismash_bgc_class_counts.csv", retained_samples)

bgc_tot <- bgc_raw %>%
  group_by(sample) %>% summarise(n_bgc = sum(n_regions), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")

cat("=== BGC totals, study isolates by class ===\n")
print(bgc_tot %>% filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte") %>%
      group_by(class) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(n_bgc), min = min(n_bgc), max = max(n_bgc)))

cat("\n=== Dothideomycete references, percentile within matched endophytes ===\n")
dot_endo <- bgc_tot$n_bgc[bgc_tot$lifestyle == "Endophyte" & bgc_tot$class == "Dothideomycetes"]
for (r in c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum", "Dsapinea", "Ztritici")) {
  v <- bgc_tot$n_bgc[bgc_tot$sample == r]
  cat(sprintf("  %-14s %3d clusters  percentile = %.1f\n", r, v, pct_of(dot_endo, v)))
}

cat("\n=== naive (unmatched) comparison, for contrast ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  all study isolates mean = %.1f ; pine pathogens mean = %.1f\n",
            mean(bgc_tot$n_bgc[bgc_tot$lifestyle == "Endophyte"]),
            mean(bgc_tot$n_bgc[bgc_tot$sample %in%
                 c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum", "Dsapinea", "Fcircinatum")])))

bgc_study <- bgc_tot %>%
  filter(lifestyle == "Endophyte", !is.na(class))

# Kruskal-Wallis on classes with more than one isolate.
cls_n <- bgc_study %>% count(class) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(class)
kw_dat <- bgc_study %>% filter(class %in% cls_n)

cat("=== BGC count ~ taxonomic class (study isolates) ===\n")
print(kw_dat %>% group_by(class) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), median = median(n_bgc), mean = round(mean(n_bgc), 1)))
print(kruskal.test(n_bgc ~ factor(class), data = kw_dat))

cat("\n=== pairwise Wilcoxon, Benjamini-Hochberg corrected ===\n")
print(pairwise.wilcox.test(kw_dat$n_bgc, factor(kw_dat$class),
                           p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE))

# Dothideomycete endophytes vs needle pathogens.
dot_endo <- bgc_study %>% filter(class == "Dothideomycetes") %>% pull(n_bgc)
needle   <- bgc_tot %>% filter(sample %in% c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum")) %>% pull(n_bgc)

cat("\n=== BGC count: Dothideomycete endophytes vs the 2 needle specialists ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  endophytes n = %d, median = %.0f ; pathogens = %s\n",
            length(dot_endo), median(dot_endo), paste(needle, collapse = ", ")))
print(wilcox.test(dot_endo, needle, exact = FALSE))
cat(sprintf("  L. acicola percentile among matched endophytes = %.1f\n",
            pct_of(dot_endo, bgc_tot$n_bgc[bgc_tot$sample == "Lacicola"])))
```

## Combined functional matrix (CAZy + COG + BGC)

```{r}
#| label: combined_stats

# Sample x feature matrices (per 1000 genes) for each block.
load_block <- function(path, value_col, feature_col) {
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(sample, feature = all_of(feature_col), value = all_of(value_col)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
    as.matrix()
}

blk_cazy <- load_block("files/cazy_family_counts.csv",
                       "count_per_1000_genes", "cazy_family")
blk_cog  <- load_block("files/cog_category_counts.csv",
                       "count_per_1000_genes", "category")
blk_bgc  <- load_block("files/antismash_bgc_class_counts.csv",
                       "n_regions_per_1000", "bgc_class")

common <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(blk_cazy), rownames(blk_cog), rownames(blk_bgc)))
cat(sprintf("samples with all three blocks: %d\n", length(common)))
blk_cazy <- blk_cazy[common, , drop = FALSE]
blk_cog  <- blk_cog[common, , drop = FALSE]
blk_bgc  <- blk_bgc[common, , drop = FALSE]

# Drop all-zero columns in each block.
drop_empty <- function(m) m[, colSums(m, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
blk_cazy <- drop_empty(blk_cazy)
blk_cog  <- drop_empty(blk_cog)
blk_bgc  <- drop_empty(blk_bgc)

cat(sprintf("block dimensions: CAZy %d vars, COG %d vars, BGC %d vars\n",
            ncol(blk_cazy), ncol(blk_cog), ncol(blk_bgc)))

# Hellinger transform each block separately.
hell_cazy <- decostand(blk_cazy, method = "hellinger")
hell_cog  <- decostand(blk_cog,  method = "hellinger")
hell_bgc  <- decostand(blk_bgc,  method = "hellinger")

# MFA block weighting: scale each block by 1 / its first singular value
# (Escofier & Pages, 1994).
block_weight <- function(m) {
  sv1 <- svd(scale(m, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE), nu = 0, nv = 0)$d[1]
  1 / sv1
}
w_cazy <- block_weight(hell_cazy)
w_cog  <- block_weight(hell_cog)
w_bgc  <- block_weight(hell_bgc)

cat(sprintf("block weights (1/first singular value): CAZy %.3f  COG %.3f  BGC %.3f\n",
            w_cazy, w_cog, w_bgc))

combined <- cbind(hell_cazy * w_cazy, hell_cog * w_cog, hell_bgc * w_bgc)
block_id <- c(rep("CAZy", ncol(hell_cazy)),
             rep("COG",  ncol(hell_cog)),
             rep("BGC",  ncol(hell_bgc)))

# PERMANOVA on the combined matrix, filamentous fungi only.
meta_c <- meta %>% filter(sample %in% common) %>% arrange(match(sample, rownames(combined)))
keep_c <- meta_c$sample[!meta_c$sample %in% YEAST_LIKE]
combined_f <- combined[keep_c, , drop = FALSE]
meta_cf    <- meta_c %>% filter(sample %in% keep_c)

combined_d <- vegdist(combined_f, method = "euclidean")

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA on the COMBINED matrix (CAZy + COG + BGC), filamentous fungi only (n =",
    length(keep_c), ") ===\n")
cat("\n-- taxonomic class --\n")
print(adonis2(combined_d ~ class, data = meta_cf, permutations = N_PERM))
cat("\n-- lifestyle --\n")
print(adonis2(combined_d ~ lifestyle, data = meta_cf, permutations = N_PERM))
cat("\n-- class + lifestyle (sequential) --\n")
print(adonis2(combined_d ~ class + lifestyle, data = meta_cf, permutations = N_PERM, by = "terms"))

cat("\n=== betadisper on the combined matrix ===\n")
print(anova(betadisper(combined_d, meta_cf$class)))
```

## Mantel tests: phylogenetic vs functional distance

```{r}
#| label: mantel_test

patristic <- cophenetic.phylo(tr)

mantel_block <- function(func_d, block_name) {
  common <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(func_d)), rownames(patristic))
  pd  <- as.dist(patristic[common, common])
  fd  <- as.dist(as.matrix(func_d)[common, common])
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Mantel test: patristic distance vs %s (n = %d) ===\n",
              block_name, length(common)))
  print(mantel(pd, fd, permutations = N_PERM))
}

mantel_block(cazy_d, "CAZy")
mantel_block(cog_d,  "COG")
mantel_block(bgc_d,  "BGC")
mantel_block(eff_d,  "Effectors")
mantel_block(combined_d,  "Combined")
```

# Figures

## Ordination helper

```{r}
#| label: ordination_helper

# PCA of a Hellinger-transformed block. Saves the plot and loadings and reports
# the correlation of PC1 with total block content.
ordinate_block <- function(mat_raw, block_label, file_stem, feature_col) {

  mat_raw <- mat_raw[, colSums(mat_raw, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  mat_raw[is.na(mat_raw)] <- 0

  # Genomes with no content in the block would give NaN after Hellinger.
  empty <- rownames(mat_raw)[rowSums(mat_raw) == 0]
  if (length(empty)) {
    warning(block_label, ": dropping ", length(empty),
            " genome(s) with zero content in this block: ",
            paste(empty, collapse = ", "))
    mat_raw <- mat_raw[rowSums(mat_raw) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  hell <- decostand(mat_raw, method = "hellinger")
  pca  <- prcomp(hell, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  ve   <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

  scores <- as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2], rownames = "sample") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(role = case_when(
             lifestyle == "Endophyte"  ~ "Endophyte (this study)",
             lifestyle == "Pathogen"   ~ "Pathogen (reference)",
             lifestyle == "Saprophyte" ~ "Saprophyte (reference)",
             TRUE                      ~ "Yeast-like (reference)")) %>%
    left_join(sci_name, by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(lab_expr = if_else(lifestyle != "Endophyte", sci_expr, ""))

  p <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = class, shape = role), size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = lab_expr), parse = TRUE,
                    point.padding = 1, box.padding = 0.5,
                    size = 3, seed = 1, max.overlaps = 20,
                    segment.colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_palette, name = "Taxonomic\nclass") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Endophyte (this study)" = 16, "Pathogen (reference)" = 17,
                 "Saprophyte (reference)" = 15, "Yeast-like (reference)" = 18),
      name = NULL) +
    labs(title = block_label,
          x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", ve[1]),
          y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", ve[2])) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2))

  save_plot(file.path("figures", file_stem), p, width = 12, height = 8)

  loadings <- as_tibble(pca$rotation[, 1:2], rownames = feature_col) %>%
    mutate(across(c(PC1, PC2), ~round(.x, 4))) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(PC1)))
  write_csv(loadings, file.path("figures", paste0(file_stem, "_loadings.csv")))

  r_total <- cor(pca$x[, 1], rowSums(mat_raw))

  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s (%d genomes, %d features) ===\n",
              block_label, nrow(mat_raw), ncol(mat_raw)))
  cat(sprintf("  PC1 = %.1f%%  PC2 = %.1f%%  PC3 = %.1f%%  (PC1+PC2 = %.1f%%)\n",
              ve[1], ve[2], ve[3], sum(ve[1:2])))
  cat(sprintf("  PC1 vs total content in block: r = %+.3f\n", r_total))
  cat("  top 5 features loading on PC1: ",
      paste(head(loadings[[feature_col]], 5), collapse = ", "), "\n")

  invisible(list(plot = p, scores = scores, loadings = loadings,
                 ve = ve, r_total = r_total, pca = pca))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig_cazy_secreted

# 'No signal peptide': never screened by the TM filter. 'Non-secreted': signal
# peptide but failed the TM filter. Denominator is all CAZyme genes.

sec_sum <- read_parsed("secreted_cazyme_summary.csv", retained_samples) %>%
            left_join(sci_name, by = "sample") |> 
            mutate(sample = if_else(!is.na(sci_expr), sci_plain, sample))

sec_order <- sec_sum  %>% 
              arrange(desc(secreted_cazy_per_1000_genes)) %>% 
              pull(sample)

sec_long <- sec_sum %>%
  select(sample,
         Secreted      = secreted_cazyme_genes,
         `Non-secreted (SP, failed TM filter)` = nonsecreted_cazyme_genes,
         `No signal peptide`    = not_assessed_cazyme_genes,
         total_genes) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(sample, total_genes),
               names_to = "status", values_to = "n_genes") %>%
  mutate(per_1000 = n_genes / total_genes * 1000,
         status   = factor(status, levels = c(
           "Secreted",
           "Non-secreted (SP, failed TM filter)",
           "No signal peptide"))) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = order_present(sample, sec_order)))

secreted_cazyme_plot <-
  ggplot(sec_long, aes(x = sample, y = per_1000, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Secreted"                            = "darkorange3",
    "Non-secreted (SP, failed TM filter)" = "grey45",
    "No signal peptide"                   = "grey80")) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "CAZyme genes per 1000", fill = NULL,
    caption  = label_caption
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    color = axis_label_colors(levels(sec_long$sample),
                              reference_samples, sci_name = TRUE),
    angle = 60, hjust = 1))

save_plot("figures/secreted_cazymes", secreted_cazyme_plot,
       width = 20, height = 8)
```

```{r}
# Uses `union_tot` from the pcwde_robustness chunk.

short_names <- c(
  "Cellulose-associated (PCWDE)" = "Cellulose",
  "Hemicellulose / xylan-associated (PCWDE)" = "Hemicellulose",
  "Mannan-associated (PCWDE)" = "Mannan",
  "Pectin-associated (PCWDE)" = "Pectin",
  "Cutin / suberin / cuticle esterase (infection-relevant)" = "Cutin",
  "Oxidative polysaccharide cleavage / LPMO" = "LPMO",
  "Auxiliary redox / lignin-related oxidation (mostly NOT lignin in Dothideomycetes)" = "AuxRedox",
  "Starch / storage glucan-associated" = "Starch",
  "Chitin / fungal cell wall - chitin (FCWE)" = "Chitin",
  "Fungal cell wall - beta/alpha-glucan (FCWE, remodelling)" = "Glucan"
)

act_w <- read_parsed("cazy_activity_group_counts.csv", retained_samples) %>%
  mutate(short = recode(activity_group, !!!short_names)) %>%
  select(sample, short, n_genes_per_1000) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = short, values_from = n_genes_per_1000, values_fill = 0) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  # Total PCWDE counts each gene once.
  left_join(union_tot %>% select(sample, PCWDE = total_inclusive), by = "sample")

cat("Dothideomycete isolate PCWDE range:",
    paste(round(range(act_w$PCWDE[act_w$class == "Dothideomycetes" &
                                  act_w$lifestyle == "Endophyte"]), 1), collapse = " to "), "\n")

traits_plot <- c("PCWDE", "Hemicellulose", "Cellulose", "Pectin", "Cutin")

matched_long <- act_w %>%
  filter(class == "Dothideomycetes") %>%
  select(sample, lifestyle, all_of(traits_plot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(traits_plot), names_to = "trait", values_to = "per_1000") %>%
  mutate(
    trait = factor(trait, levels = traits_plot),
    grp   = case_when(
      sample %in% c("Lacicola", "Dseptosporum") ~ "Needle specialist",
      lifestyle == "Pathogen"                   ~ "Other pathogen",
      TRUE                                      ~ "Endophyte (this study)")
  )

matched_long_pcwde <- matched_long |> filter(trait == "PCWDE")
matched_long_ind <- matched_long |> filter(trait != "PCWDE")

plot_pcwde <- function(matched_df){
    ggplot(matched_df %>% filter(grp == "Endophyte (this study)"),
    aes(x = trait, y = per_1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey90", color = "grey45") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.45, color = "grey30") +
  geom_point(
    data = matched_df %>% filter(grp != "Endophyte (this study)"),
    aes(color = sample, shape = grp, size = grp), stroke = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(4, 3),  name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(Lacicola = "#D6212B", Dseptosporum = "#F07818",
               Dsapinea = "#3B7DD8", Ztritici = "#228B22"),
               breaks = sci_name$sample, labels = sci_name$sci_md, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Needle specialist" = 18, "Other pathogen" = 17),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Genes per 1,000 predicted genes") +
  theme(legend.text = element_markdown(),
        legend.position = "bottom")+
  guides(size = guide_legend(ncol = 1), color = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
}

pcwde_matched_plot <- 
  ggarrange(plot_pcwde(matched_long_pcwde),
          plot_pcwde(matched_long_ind) + rremove("ylab"),
          labels = c("A", "B"), widths = c(1,3),
          common.legend = TRUE,
          legend = "bottom")
  

save_plot("figures/pcwde_matched_dothideomycetes", pcwde_matched_plot, width = 12, height = 8)
```

## Supplementary

### QC: genome size, N50 and BUSCO completeness

```{r}
#| label: fig_qc_size_busco
#| fig-width: 40
#| fig-height: 15

n50_scale <- max(qc_all$genome_size_mb, na.rm = TRUE) /
             max(qc_all$n50_kb, na.rm = TRUE)

genome_size_plot <- ggplot(qc_all, aes(x = reorder(sample, genome_size_mb))) +
  geom_col(aes(y = genome_size_mb),fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(y = n50_kb * n50_scale), color = "firebrick", size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "Genome size (Mb)",
    expand   = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / n50_scale, name = "Contig N50 (kb)")
  ) +
  labs(
    x       = NULL,
    caption = "Bars: genome size (left axis). Red points: contig N50 (right axis)."
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "firebrick"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "firebrick"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) 

# BUSCO completeness

busco_long <- qc_all %>%
  select(sample,
         single_copy = sc_percent,
         duplicated  = mc_percent,
         fragmented  = f_percent,
         missing     = m_percent) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "category", values_to = "percent")

busco_sample_order <- qc_all %>% arrange(desc(m_percent)) %>% pull(sample)
busco_long <- busco_long %>%
  mutate(
    sample   = factor(sample, levels = busco_sample_order),
    category = factor(category,
                      levels = c("single_copy", "duplicated", "fragmented", "missing"))
  )

busco_colors <- c("single_copy" = "dodgerblue4", "duplicated" = "steelblue",
                  "fragmented"  = "goldenrod",   "missing"    = "lightcoral")

# Mark the genomes the duplication threshold removes.
busco_excluded <- qc_all %>% filter(!passes_qc) %>% pull(sample)

busco_plot <- ggplot(busco_long, aes(x = sample, y = percent, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = busco_colors,
    labels = c("Single copy", "Duplicated", "Fragmented", "Missing")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Percentage of BUSCO genes"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1,
          face  = if_else(levels(busco_long$sample) %in% busco_excluded,
                          "bold.italic", "plain"),
          color = if_else(levels(busco_long$sample) %in% busco_excluded,
                          "firebrick", "grey20")))

size_busco_plot <- ggarrange(genome_size_plot, busco_plot, ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
                             labels = c("A", "B"))
save_plot("figures/size_busco_plot", size_busco_plot, width = 40, height = 15)
```

### Effector class composition (ternary)

```{r}
#| label: fig_effector_ternary
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8

# Three-part composition summing to 1 per genome, so a ternary plot rather than a PCA.

eff_tern <- read_csv("files/effectorp_class_counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(effector_class != "Non-effector") %>%
  select(sample, effector_class, n_genes) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = effector_class, values_from = n_genes, values_fill = 0)

# Genomes with no predicted effectors have no composition; report and drop them.
n_eff_total <- rowSums(eff_tern[, c("Apoplastic", "Cytoplasmic", "Dual")])
if (any(n_eff_total == 0)) {
  cat(sprintf("dropped %d genome(s) with zero predicted effectors: %s\n",
              sum(n_eff_total == 0),
              paste(eff_tern$sample[n_eff_total == 0], collapse = ", ")))
}

eff_tern <- eff_tern %>%
  filter(n_eff_total > 0) %>%
  mutate(n_effectors = Apoplastic + Cytoplasmic + Dual) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sci_name, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    role = case_when(
      lifestyle == "Endophyte"  ~ "Endophyte (this study)",
      lifestyle == "Pathogen"   ~ "Pathogen (reference)",
      lifestyle == "Saprophyte" ~ "Saprophyte (reference)",
      TRUE                      ~ "Yeast-like (reference)"),
    lab_expr = if_else(lifestyle != "Endophyte", sci_expr, ""))

cat(sprintf("\nternary plot: %d genomes\n", nrow(eff_tern)))
cat("mean proportions by lifestyle:\n")
print(eff_tern %>%
        mutate(across(c(Apoplastic, Cytoplasmic, Dual), ~ .x / n_effectors)) %>%
        group_by(lifestyle) %>%
        summarise(n = n(),
                  across(c(Apoplastic, Cytoplasmic, Dual),
                         ~ round(mean(.x), 3)), .groups = "drop"))
```

```{r}
           fill = list(count_per_1000_genes = 0)) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = order_present(sample, sample_order))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample))

cat_order <- cog %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(count_per_1000_genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(m) %>% pull(category)
cog <- cog %>% mutate(category = factor(category, levels = cat_order))

to_matrix <- function(df, value_col) {
  df %>%
    select(sample, category, all_of(value_col)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = all_of(value_col),
                values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    t()                       # rows = category, cols = sample
}

cog_matrix <- to_matrix(cog, "count_per_1000_genes")

keep_cog <- c("G", "Q", "T", "V", "O", "U", "I", "P")
cog_filtered_matrix <- cog %>%
  filter(category_code %in% keep_cog) %>%
  to_matrix("count_per_1000_genes")

draw_heatmap(cog_matrix,          "cog_plot")
draw_heatmap(cog_filtered_matrix, "cog_plot_filtered")
```

### BGC classes (heatmap)

```{r}
#| label: fig_bgc_class_heatmap
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 8

bgc_matrix <- bgc_raw %>%
  select(sample, bgc_class, n_regions_per_1000) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bgc_class, values_from = n_regions_per_1000,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
  as.matrix() %>% t()

bgc_matrix <- bgc_matrix[
  , order_present(colnames(bgc_matrix), sample_order), drop = FALSE
]

draw_heatmap(bgc_matrix, "bgc_bgc_class_plot",
            title = "Secondary metabolite cluster classes per genome")
```

### BGC regions on contig edges

```{r}
#| label: fig_bgc_contig_edge
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 8

bgc_regions <- read_parsed("antismash_regions_long.csv", retained_samples)

edge_summary <- bgc_regions %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = order_present(sample, sample_order))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample)) %>%
  count(sample, contig_edge) %>%
  complete(sample, contig_edge, fill = list(n = 0))

edge_plot <- ggplot(edge_summary,
                    aes(x = sample, y = n, fill = contig_edge)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "steelblue4", `TRUE` = "firebrick"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Complete", `TRUE` = "Truncated (contig edge)"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Number of BGC regions"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    color = axis_label_colors(levels(edge_summary$sample), reference_samples),
    angle = 60, hjust = 1))

save_plot("figures/bgc_contig_edge", edge_plot, width = 16, height = 6)
```
